focused.qualification: Additive test-only adapter on exactly the frozen Module24 production source. Full base regression continues separately; every backend executes the added normal tests here. External corpus runs are separate.

corpus.qualification: Every pinned input ran through both unmodified native non-stateful fuzz targets (normal and ASan/UBSan) and both Rust release adapters, with zero skipped files. Native and Rust stable selector, reserved source prefix, buffer capacity, initial output size and first input size match for every file. Rust fixed destinations have real guard checks. Buffered aggregate output/window caps and non-stateful context lifetime remain explicit bounded adaptations; no complete target parity claim.

fixture_provenance.qualification: All omitted fixture bytes matched the recorded repository commit working tree before archival; full hashes are retained. No source downloaded for study is included.
